system_log_fire_event.title: PERMEAR error monitor is inactive
system_log_fire_event.description:
The error monitor needs the system_log integration to fire events. Add the following to configuration.yaml and restart:

```yaml
system_log:
  fire_event: true
```

Without it, no error cards will be sent to Telegram.
